/** * Calculate an ISBN-10 or ISBN-13 check digit, depending * on the length of the code. *

* If the length of the code is 9, it is treated as an ISBN-10 * code or if the length of the code is 12, it is treated as an ISBN-13 * code. * * @param code The ISBN code to validate (should have a length of * 9 or 12) * @return The ISBN-10 check digit if the length is 9 or an ISBN-13 * check digit if the length is 12. * @throws CheckDigitException if the code is missing, or an invalid * length (i.e. not 9 or 12) or if there is an error calculating the * check digit. */
